key_terms.أَنذِرْ: Warn or give notice of danger

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran command regarding warning one's close relatives?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the event of Daw al-Ashira, where the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) first invited his clan to Islam, emphasizing the primacy of the Ahl al-Bayt in the propagation of the message. It underscores the dual role of the Prophet as both a warner to the broader community and a guide to his immediate kin, establishing a hierarchical model for da'wah that begins with the closest relatives.
